assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations.
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The symptomatic events need to be correlated with underlying arrhythmias.
Rate control management optimization is a goal of the service.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is indicated for this patient.
The purpose of the monitoring is continuous rhythm assessment.
The service addresses the specific clinical need described in the indication note.
